interface {
    backend netlink;
    ethernet eth0 {
        mac {
            address 00:11:22:33:44:55;
        }
        description "uplink to the exchange";
    }
    bridge br0 {
        mac {
            address 02:00:00:00:00:03;
        }
    }
}
firewall {
    backend nft;
    table golden {
        family inet;
        set blocked {
            type ipv4;
            element 10.0.0.1 {}
        }
        chain input {
            type filter;
            hook input;
            priority 0;
            policy accept;
            term block-known {
                from { source-address "@blocked"; }
                then { drop; }
            }
        }
    }
}
system {
    host golden
    domain example.net
}
